body:
Refreshed with main (c8a1bab1): `upstream/main` merged in with no textual conflict. Head is now a7179f8b. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` stays at main's 18, since this slice bumps nothing.

Main's merge brought in a semantic break. Main's recorded-stream guards (b471395e) build `Dump { wcs: "G54" }`, at `crates/post/tests/recorded_streams.rs:44` and `crates/app/tests/recorded_post_streams.rs:75,142`. Since this slice made `Dump::wcs` a u32 index, those literals are now `wcs: 1`.

Stream files: I regenerated them, through the suites' documented path (`WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p camcraft-post --test recorded_streams` and `-p camcraft-app --test recorded_post_streams`). Slice 1's legacy-word path still reads `PARAM WorkOffset G54` as 1, so leaving the files alone was considered. It was dropped because the guards compare the dump's output to each file byte for byte, and with the index literal six of the post guards failed as stale. The dump writes the index, so the files must carry it. The only diff is `PARAM WorkOffset G54` -> `PARAM WorkOffset 1.000000`: 9 lines in 8 generated streams. The hand-written `full_circle_raw.cnc` stays as it is. It round-trips unchanged and keeps covering the legacy-word read.

Posted goldens: every file under `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/<post>/` is byte-identical (`git status` shows no change there). Each script suite posts the regenerated streams against them and passes 9/9: carvera, doosan_dnm, fanuc, fanuc_lathe, haas, heidenhain, mazak, sinumerik, tormach, tormach_lathe. `script_tormach_plasma` fails 8, the known #1146 on main: its refusal text is stale ("no machine is stated"), unrelated to the work offset.

Tests: all of `camcraft-post --tests` except that suite is green (recorded_streams 10, work_offset_index 9, post_engine 33, ...). App `recorded_post_streams` 2/2, `wcs_index` 4/4, `fanuc_post` 11/11, `inverted_probe` 9/9, `probe_dialects` 13/13, `sinumerik_work_offsets` 2/2. Clippy `-D warnings` is clean on post `--all-targets` and on app `--lib --test recorded_post_streams`; it ran per target because of #1146. Stays draft.

Refreshed with main (6a10c5ad), merged in through the refreshed parent #1101 (558e61e5). No textual conflicts: both sides regenerated the recorded streams to the same `PARAM WorkOffset 1.000000`. After that, merging main directly was already up to date. Main added no new Dump literals or streams that needed the index rule, and no golden moved. PROCESS_VERSION is 25, the same as main; this PR doesn't change it. Head a9f8e289.

Tests: every camcraft-post suite passes: `work_offset_index` 9, `recorded_streams` 10, all eleven `script_*` suites 9 each, `post_engine` 33. App `wcs_index` 4/4, `mcp` 18/18, `recorded_post_streams` 2/2, `sinumerik_work_offsets` 2/2. Clippy on post, app and ui with `-D warnings` is clean. Mergeable. (There is no `mcp_work_offset` suite on this branch, so I ran nothing under that name.)
Quick pass (M5): body complete, gate reported green on this head, no open requested change; flagged ready for review. Conflicts with main (if any) are refreshed at merge time (PROCESS_VERSION 31).
Back to draft (M5): my quick pass readied this by mistake. It's held for the user's PathPilot Hub run, and there's no hands-on result yet. It goes ready again once that run is recorded.
taken by SKULL for the refresh @ a9f8e289

Merge-time refresh: merged the freshly pushed parent `issue/931-wcs-index-post` (#1101 @ 3460d7ba, which carries upstream/main 2d15a617), then `upstream/main` (already up to date). New head **2871b646** (plain merge commit, no rebase, no force).

Per-file resolutions:
- `crates/app/src/mcp/setup_tools.rs`: imports - main's new `PostRef`, `api`, `inventory` kept; `WCS_SLOTS` dropped as this slice does.
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs`: imports - main's `stock::StockShape` + `stock_fit::FitKind` kept; `WCS_SLOTS` dropped.
- `crates/app/src/operation/types/mod.rs`: main's `sinker` / `wire_edm` re-exports kept; the `sel` line takes this slice's form (no `WCS_SLOTS`, `pub(crate) use sel::LEGACY_WCS_NAMES`).
- `crates/post/tests/inverted_probe.rs`, `crates/post/tests/probe_dialects.rs`: main moved these from `crates/app/tests/` to the post crate and made them read recorded inputs; main's form taken. The recorded inputs already carry `PARAM WorkOffset 1.000000` (from #1101), so the slice's index change needs no edit there.
- Semantic follow-through (main's new code on the old API, no textual conflict): `crates/app/src/setup_wcs_tilt.rs` (tilted-WCS refusal text) and `crates/app/src/mcp/wcs_tools.rs` (MCP reply `word`) read the name through `setup::wcs_name` instead of `WCS_SLOTS` - the same replacement this slice made in `setup_tools.rs`; display only. `Dump` literals in `crates/post/tests/script_fanuc_lathe.rs`, `crates/app/tests/probe_no_coolant.rs` and `crates/app/tests/recorded_post_streams.rs` take `wcs: 1` for `"G54"`.
- `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`, snapshot PNGs, `CHANGELOG.md`, `RECOMMENDED.md`: main's (untouched by this PR).

Output check: no `.cnc`, `.cps`, `.cl` or golden file differs from the refreshed parent; the PR's delta is the pre-refresh delta plus only the follow-through lines above. The posted output the Hub run tested stands (G54/G59 unchanged, G59.1-G59.3 as tested, offset 10 refused by name).

Gate on 2871b646:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green - post suites (66 s), app suites (1969 s), ui suites (190 s): 3823 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

ready for review (M3/M5)

Refreshed at merge time: #1101 merged to main, so main was merged into this branch (plain merge commit, no rebase, no force). New head 68e8ffbf.

Delta class: DELTA (one conflict resolved by hand). No collaborator pr-reviewer marker exists on this PR, so the class is measured against the previous head 2871b646.

Resolved by hand: `crates/app/src/operation/types/mod.rs`. Both sides edited the `sel` re-export line (main still re-exported `WCS_SLOTS`, which this slice removes). Kept this slice's form: no `WCS_SLOTS`, `pub(crate) use sel::LEGACY_WCS_NAMES`. No design choice; `WCS_SLOTS` has no remaining use in `crates/`, and the work offset is still read from the setup. No golden, snapshot or PROCESS_VERSION change.

Gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` green: post suites, app suites, app probe_no_coolant (1 fn), ui suites, 0 failed.

Not exercised: clippy, release-lane suites and snapshots, the GUI.

|---|---|---|---|
| refresh (merge of main) | Sonnet 5.5 | 97k | ~$0.27 |
| review | Fable 5.2 (priced as Opus) | 208k | ~$1.16 |
| **Total** | | **305k** | **~$1.43** |

Blended upper estimate (90 % input / 10 % output at list price). Main-session coordination isn't counted.

Merged under the maintainer's standing answers ("Assume yes on all merges"; reviewed feat PRs merge now, the cut comes later). Notes for the release notes: this changes which work-offset word a program posts; project files that use offset 7 or higher cannot be opened by older builds, so the next release notes should list it as breaking. Not exercised: GUI, release lanes, a user .cps post with extended offsets.
